$comment: Known high/critical npm advisories that are deliberately left in the tree, and why (#337). Read by scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and dev_only (true holds only while `npm audit --omit=dev` does not report the same advisory); an entry that stops matching fails CI so it is removed. Never add one to make CI green without saying what would have to change for it to be fixed.
$empty: Nothing is accepted right now, and that is the state to keep. The one entry this file used to carry — braces GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm, reachable only through eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob@3.3.1 -> micromatch — stopped matching when eslint-config-next@16.4.6 dropped that chain, and a stale entry fails the gate by design (#498). The two advisories that were open alongside it are fixed rather than accepted: next 16.3.8 -> 16.4.6 (GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw, unauthenticated RCE in the Image Optimization API, plus GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r) and a zod override to >=4.6.6 in both projects (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5). An acceptance was not available for the zod one in sentra/eval: it arrives through openai and @openai/agents, which are production dependencies there, so dev_only: true would have been false.
